description: Dismiss a GitHub issue so it no longer appears in notifications, or a PR so its merged-PR maintainer notes or review follow-up stop being raised. For a review follow-up, pass the entry’s headSha as `head` so the PR stays hidden until a new push or comment.

head.description: PR URLs only: the PR's full head SHA at dismiss time (the review follow-up entry's headSha)

url.description: Full GitHub issue or PR URL to dismiss

name: dismiss
